records.literal_gloss: Hear this, the priests, and pay attention, house of Israel, and house of the king, give ear; for to you [is] the judgment; for a snare you have been to Mizpah, and a net spread out over Tabor.

en.L: Hear this, priests, and pay attention, house of Israel, and house of the king, give ear, \q for to you [belongs] the judgment; \q for a snare you have been at Mizpah, \q and a net spread out over Tabor.
en.B: Hear this, you priests! Pay attention, house of Israel! Listen, royal house! \q The judgment is against you, \q for you have been a trap at Mizpah, \q a net spread out on Tabor.
en.R: Listen to this, you priests! Pay attention, people of Israel! Listen, you members of the king's family! \q This judgment is against you, \q because you have been like a trap set at Mizpah, \q like a net spread out on Mount Tabor.

es.L: {{plural_you:Oigan|Oíd}} esto, sacerdotes, y {{plural_you:presten|prestad}} atención, casa de Israel, y casa del rey, {{plural_you:escuchen|escuchad}}, \q porque contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} [es] el juicio; \q porque {{plural_you:han sido|habéis sido}} una trampa en Mizpa \q y una red tendida sobre el Tabor.
es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}} esto, sacerdotes! ¡{{plural_you:Presten|Prestad}} atención, casa de Israel! ¡{{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}}, casa real! \q El juicio es contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, \q porque {{plural_you:han sido|habéis sido}} una trampa en Mizpa, \q una red tendida sobre el Tabor.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}} esto, sacerdotes! ¡{{plural_you:Presten|Prestad}} atención, pueblo de Israel! ¡{{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}}, familia del rey! \q Este juicio es contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, \q porque {{plural_you:han sido|habéis sido}} como una trampa puesta en Mizpa, \q como una red tendida sobre el monte Tabor.

fr.L: Écoutez ceci, prêtres, et soyez attentifs, maison d’Israël, et maison du roi, prêtez l’oreille, \q car c’est à vous [qu’appartient] le jugement ; \q car vous avez été un piège à Mitspa, \q et un filet tendu sur le Thabor.
fr.B: Écoutez ceci, prêtres ! Soyez attentifs, maison d’Israël ! Prêtez l’oreille, maison royale ! \q Le jugement est contre vous, \q car vous avez été un piège à Mitspa, \q un filet tendu sur le Thabor.
fr.R: Écoutez ceci, prêtres ! Faites attention, peuple d’Israël ! Écoutez, membres de la famille du roi ! \q Ce jugement est contre vous, \q parce que vous avez été comme un piège posé à Mitspa, \q comme un filet étendu sur le mont Thabor.

ko.L: 제사장들아, 이것을 들어라. 이스라엘 집아, 주의하여라. 왕의 집아, 귀를 기울여라. \q 심판이 너희에게 [내린다]. \q 너희가 미스바에서 올무가 되었고, \q 다볼 위에 펼쳐진 그물이 되었기 때문이다.
ko.B: 제사장들아, 이것을 들어라! 이스라엘 집아, 귀담아들어라! 왕실아, 귀를 기울여라! \q 너희에게 심판이 내린다. \q 너희는 미스바에서 덫이 되었고, \q 다볼 위에 펼쳐 놓은 그물이 되었다.
ko.R: 제사장들아, 이것을 들어라! 이스라엘 백성아, 귀담아들어라! 왕의 집안 사람들아, 들어라! \q 이 심판은 너희에게 내리는 것이다. \q 너희는 미스바에 놓은 덫과 같았고, \q 다볼 산 위에 펼쳐 놓은 그물과 같았다.

vi.L: Hãy nghe điều này, hỡi các thầy tế lễ; hãy chú ý, hỡi nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên; hỡi nhà của vua, hãy lắng tai, \q vì sự phán xét [thuộc] về các ngươi; \q vì các ngươi đã là cái bẫy tại Mích-ba, \q và là tấm lưới giăng trên Tha-bô.
vi.B: Hỡi các thầy tế lễ, hãy nghe điều này! Hỡi nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên, hãy chú ý! Hỡi hoàng tộc, hãy lắng nghe! \q Sự phán xét nghịch cùng các ngươi, \q vì các ngươi đã là cái bẫy tại Mích-ba, \q là tấm lưới giăng trên Tha-bô.
vi.R: Hỡi các thầy tế lễ, hãy nghe điều này! Hỡi dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, hãy chú ý! Hỡi những người trong gia đình nhà vua, hãy lắng nghe! \q Sự phán xét này dành cho các ngươi, \q vì các ngươi giống như cái bẫy đặt tại Mích-ba, \q như tấm lưới giăng trên núi Tha-bô.

sw.L: Sikieni haya, enyi makuhani, sikilizeni, enyi nyumba ya Israeli, nanyi nyumba ya mfalme, tegeni masikio, \q kwa maana hukumu [ni] juu yenu; \q kwa maana mmekuwa mtego huko Mizpa, \q na wavu uliotandwa juu ya Tabori.
sw.B: Sikieni haya, enyi makuhani! Sikilizeni, enyi nyumba ya Israeli! Tegeni masikio, enyi nyumba ya kifalme! \q Hukumu ni dhidi yenu, \q kwa maana mmekuwa mtego huko Mizpa, \q wavu uliotandwa juu ya Tabori.
sw.R: Sikilizeni haya, enyi makuhani! Sikilizeni, enyi watu wa Israeli! Sikilizeni, enyi jamaa ya mfalme! \q Hukumu hii ni dhidi yenu, \q kwa sababu mmekuwa kama mtego uliotegwa huko Mizpa, \q kama wavu uliotandwa juu ya mlima Tabori.

pt.L: Ouçam isto, sacerdotes, e prestem atenção, casa de Israel, e casa do rei, escutem, \q porque a vocês [pertence] o julgamento; \q porque vocês foram um laço em Mispá \q e uma rede estendida sobre o Tabor.
pt.B: Ouçam isto, sacerdotes! Prestem atenção, casa de Israel! Escutem, casa real! \q O julgamento é contra vocês, \q porque vocês foram uma armadilha em Mispá, \q uma rede estendida sobre o Tabor.
pt.R: Ouçam isto, sacerdotes! Prestem atenção, povo de Israel! Escutem, membros da família do rei! \q Este julgamento é contra vocês, \q porque vocês foram como uma armadilha montada em Mispá, \q como uma rede estendida sobre o monte Tabor.

decisions.choice: to you is the judgment: the judgment is against you
decisions.reason: The words can mean "the judgment is for you", that is, it is aimed at you, or "justice is your business", that is, you were the ones responsible for justice. Both fit the priests and the king's house, and the second makes their failure the reason for the first. The translation takes the first, which leads into the charges that follow.

decisions.choice: priests, house of Israel, house of the king: the leaders and the whole people
decisions.reason: The call goes to the priests, to the house of Israel (either the people or its leading families), and to the royal household. All of them are summoned to hear the charge, as in 4:1.

decisions.choice: a snare at Mizpah, a net spread over Tabor: Israel's leaders trapped the people at well-known places
decisions.reason: A snare and a net were a hunter's tools for catching birds and animals. Instead of protecting the people, the leaders caught them, probably by leading them into false worship at shrines in these places. Mount Tabor rises over the Jezreel valley in Galilee; Mizpah may be the town of that name in Gilead, east of the Jordan (Genesis 31:49), or the one in Benjamin (1 Samuel 7:5-6). Both were perhaps places of worship.

decisions.choice: like a trap set ... Mount Tabor
decisions.reason: Readable makes the picture a comparison and says that Tabor is a mountain.

decisions.choice: royal house (Balanced); members of the king's family (Readable)
decisions.reason: "House of the king" means the royal family and court.

decisions.choice: "Mizpa", "el Tabor"
decisions.reason: The published Spanish forms of the place names (Judges, Samuel); Readable adds "monte", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "Mích-ba", "Tha-bô"
decisions.reason: The place names as published (1 Samuel 7; Judges 4).

decisions.choice: Mispá; o Tabor (L, B), o monte Tabor (R)
decisions.reason: The places take the forms Judges 20:1 and 1 Samuel 7:16 give them in Portuguese; Readable says that Tabor is a mountain, as the English does (r-en-1). The call is to several groups, so "vocês".

records.literal_gloss: And slaughter rebels have made deep, and I [am] discipline to all of them.

en.L: And in slaughter rebels have gone deep, \q but I [am] discipline for all of them.
en.B: The rebels have sunk deep in slaughter, \q but I will discipline them all.
en.R: The rebels have gone deep into killing, \q but I will discipline all of them.

es.L: Y en la matanza los rebeldes se han hundido, \q pero yo [soy] corrección para todos ellos.
es.B: Los rebeldes se han hundido en la matanza, \q pero yo los corregiré a todos.
es.R: Los rebeldes se han hundido en la matanza, \q pero yo los corregiré a todos.

fr.L: Et dans le massacre les rebelles sont allés profond, \q mais {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, [je suis] une correction pour eux tous.
fr.B: Les rebelles se sont enfoncés dans le massacre, \q mais je les corrigerai tous.
fr.R: Les rebelles sont allés loin dans les meurtres, \q mais je vais tous les corriger.

ko.L: 반역자들이 살육에 깊이 빠졌으나, \q 나는 그들 모두를 징계하는 이다.
ko.B: 반역자들이 살육에 깊이 빠져 있으나, \q 내가 그들을 모두 징계하겠다.
ko.R: 반역자들은 사람 죽이는 일에 깊이 빠졌다. \q 그러나 나는 그들을 모두 징계하겠다.

vi.L: Những kẻ phản loạn đã đi sâu vào sự tàn sát, \q nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [là] sự sửa phạt cho tất cả chúng.
vi.B: Những kẻ phản loạn đã lún sâu vào sự chém giết, \q nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ sửa phạt tất cả chúng.
vi.R: Những kẻ phản loạn đã lao sâu vào việc giết chóc, \q nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ sửa phạt hết thảy chúng.

sw.L: Na waasi wamezama sana katika machinjo, \q lakini {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] marudi kwao wote.
sw.B: Waasi wamezama sana katika mauaji, \q lakini nitawarudi wote.
sw.R: Waasi wamezama sana katika kuua watu, \q lakini nitawaadhibu wote.

pt.L: E na matança os rebeldes se aprofundaram, \q mas eu [sou] disciplina para todos eles.
pt.B: Os rebeldes se afundaram na matança, \q mas eu disciplinarei a todos eles.
pt.R: Os rebeldes foram longe demais na matança, \q mas eu vou disciplinar todos eles.

decisions.choice: the rebels have sunk deep in slaughter (the Hebrew text as it stands)
alternatives: they have made deep the pit at Shittim
decisions.reason: The first half of the verse is one of the hardest in Hosea. As it is read, it says that rebels have gone deep in slaughter, perhaps the slaughter of sacrifices, perhaps killing. A slight change in the Hebrew letters would give "they have made deep the pit of Shittim", a third place-name trap after Mizpah and Tabor in verse 1; Shittim was where Israel first joined in the worship of Baal of Peor (Numbers 25:1-3; Hosea 9:10). The translation follows the Hebrew text as it stands.

decisions.choice: I am discipline for all of them: I will correct them all
decisions.reason: "Discipline" (musar) is correction by a father or teacher, including punishment (Proverbs 3:11-12). The LORD says that he himself is their discipline: he will bring correction on every one of them.

decisions.choice: "marudi" (L), "nitawarudi" (B)
decisions.reason: "Kurudi" (to correct, discipline) is the Swahili word for a parent's or teacher's correction, close to the Hebrew *musar*; Readable says "nitawaadhibu" (punish).

source.text: אֲנִי֙ יָדַ֣עְתִּי אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֹֽא־נִכְחַ֣ד מִמֶּ֑נִּי כִּ֤י עַתָּה֙ הִזְנֵ֣יתָ אֶפְרַ֔יִם נִטְמָ֖א יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: I know Ephraim, and Israel not is hidden from me; for now you have prostituted [yourself], Ephraim; is defiled Israel.

en.L: I know Ephraim, \q and Israel is not hidden from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}; \q because now you have prostituted yourself, Ephraim; \q Israel is defiled.
en.B: I know Ephraim; \q Israel is not hidden from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. \q For now, Ephraim, you have prostituted yourself; \q Israel has become unclean.
en.R: I know all about Ephraim; \q Israel cannot hide from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. \q Ephraim, you have now been unfaithful; \q Israel has made itself unclean.

es.L: Yo conozco a Efraín, \q e Israel no está escondido de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}; \q porque ahora te has prostituido, Efraín; \q Israel está contaminado.
es.B: Yo conozco a Efraín; \q Israel no se me oculta. \q Pues ahora, Efraín, te has prostituido; \q Israel se ha vuelto impuro.
es.R: Yo sé todo acerca de Efraín; \q Israel no puede esconderse de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. \q Efraín, ahora has sido infiel; \q Israel se ha hecho impuro.

fr.L: Je connais Éphraïm, \q et Israël n’est pas caché pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ; \q car maintenant tu t’es prostitué, Éphraïm ; \q Israël est souillé.
fr.B: Je connais Éphraïm ; \q Israël ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}est pas caché. \q Car maintenant, Éphraïm, tu t’es prostitué ; \q Israël s’est rendu impur.
fr.R: Je sais tout d’Éphraïm ; \q Israël ne peut pas se cacher de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. \q Éphraïm, maintenant tu as été infidèle ; \q Israël s’est rendu impur.

ko.L: 나는 에브라임을 안다. \q 이스라엘은 나에게서 숨겨지지 않는다. \q 에브라임아, 이제 네가 음행했고, \q 이스라엘이 더럽혀졌다.
ko.B: 나는 에브라임을 안다. \q 이스라엘은 내게서 숨을 수 없다. \q 에브라임아, 이제 너는 음행을 저질렀고, \q 이스라엘은 더러워졌다.
ko.R: 나는 에브라임에 대해 다 안다. \q 이스라엘은 나에게서 숨을 수 없다. \q 에브라임아, 너는 이제 신실하지 않았다. \q 이스라엘은 스스로를 더럽혔다.

vi.L: Ta biết Ép-ra-im, \q và Y-sơ-ra-ên không bị giấu khỏi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}; \q vì bây giờ ngươi đã làm điếm, hỡi Ép-ra-im; \q Y-sơ-ra-ên đã bị ô uế.
vi.B: Ta biết Ép-ra-im; \q Y-sơ-ra-ên không giấu được {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Vì bây giờ, hỡi Ép-ra-im, ngươi đã làm điếm; \q Y-sơ-ra-ên đã trở nên ô uế.
vi.R: Ta biết rõ mọi điều về Ép-ra-im; \q Y-sơ-ra-ên không thể trốn khỏi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Hỡi Ép-ra-im, giờ đây ngươi đã bất trung; \q Y-sơ-ra-ên đã tự làm mình ô uế.

sw.L: Mimi namjua Efraimu, \q wala Israeli hakufichika {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}; \q kwa maana sasa umefanya ukahaba, Efraimu; \q Israeli amenajisika.
sw.B: Ninamjua Efraimu; \q Israeli hajafichika {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}. \q Kwa maana sasa, Efraimu, umefanya ukahaba; \q Israeli amekuwa najisi.
sw.R: Ninajua kila kitu kuhusu Efraimu; \q Israeli hawezi kujificha {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}. \q Efraimu, sasa hujakuwa mwaminifu; \q Israeli amejifanya najisi.

pt.L: Eu conheço Efraim, \q e Israel não está escondido de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}; \q porque agora te prostituíste, Efraim; \q Israel está contaminado.
pt.B: Eu conheço Efraim; \q Israel não está escondido de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}. \q Pois agora, Efraim, tu te prostituíste; \q Israel se tornou impuro.
pt.R: Eu sei tudo sobre Efraim; \q Israel não consegue se esconder de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}. \q Efraim, agora tu foste infiel; \q Israel se fez impuro.

decisions.choice: Ephraim and Israel: the same people, the northern kingdom
decisions.reason: The two names are used in parallel for one nation, the northern kingdom (see 4:17). The LORD knows them through and through, though they do not know him (verse 4).

decisions.choice: you have prostituted yourself: Ephraim's unfaithfulness to the LORD
decisions.reason: See 4:10. The form of the verb may also mean "you have led others into prostitution".

decisions.choice: defiled: made unclean, unfit to come before God
decisions.reason: Being unclean barred a person from worship (Leviticus 15:31). Sexual sin and the worship of other gods defiled the people and the land (Leviticus 18:24-28; Hosea 6:10).

decisions.choice: prostituted yourself (Literal, Balanced); been unfaithful (Readable)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for zanah (4:10).

source.text: לֹ֤א יִתְּנוּ֙ מַ֣עַלְלֵיהֶ֔ם לָשׁ֖וּב אֶל־אֱלֹֽהֵיהֶ֑ם כִּ֣י ר֤וּחַ זְנוּנִים֙ בְּקִרְבָּ֔ם וְאֶת־יְהוָ֖ה לֹ֥א יָדָֽעוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Not they permit their deeds to return to their God; for a spirit of prostitution [is] in their midst, and Yahweh not they know.

en.L: Their deeds do not let [them] return to their God, \q for a spirit of prostitution [is] in their midst, \q and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} they do not know.
en.B: Their deeds will not let them return to their God, \q because a spirit of prostitution is in them, \q and they do not know {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Their own deeds will not let them come back to their God. \q A desire to be unfaithful is deep inside them, \q and they do not know {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Sus obras no [los] dejan volver a su Dios, \q porque un espíritu de prostitución [está] en medio de ellos, \q y {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} no conocen.
es.B: Sus obras no les permiten volver a su Dios, \q porque un espíritu de prostitución está en ellos, \q y no conocen {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: Sus propias obras no les dejan volver a su Dios. \q El deseo de ser infieles está muy dentro de ellos, \q y no conocen {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Leurs actions ne [les] laissent pas revenir à leur Dieu, \q car un esprit de prostitution [est] au milieu d’eux, \q et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, ils ne {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} connaissent pas.
fr.B: Leurs actions ne les laissent pas revenir à leur Dieu, \q car un esprit de prostitution est en eux, \q et ils ne connaissent pas {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Leurs propres actions les empêchent de revenir à leur Dieu. \q Le désir d’être infidèles est au fond d’eux, \q et ils ne connaissent pas {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

ko.L: 그들의 행실이 [그들을] 그들의 하나님께로 돌아가지 못하게 한다. \q 음행의 영이 그들 가운데 있어서, \q 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 알지 못한다.
ko.B: 그들의 행실이 그들을 하나님께로 돌아가지 못하게 한다. \q 음행의 영이 그들 속에 있어서, \q 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 알지 못한다.
ko.R: 그들은 자기들이 한 짓 때문에 하나님께로 돌아갈 수 없다. \q 신실하지 않으려는 마음이 그들 속 깊이 있어서, \q 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 알지 못한다.

vi.L: Việc làm của chúng không để [chúng] trở về với Đức Chúa Trời của chúng, \q vì một tinh thần đàng điếm [ở] giữa chúng, \q và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thì chúng không biết.
vi.B: Việc làm của chúng không cho chúng quay về với Đức Chúa Trời mình, \q vì tinh thần lăng loàn ở trong chúng, \q và chúng không biết {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Chính những việc chúng làm không cho chúng trở về với Đức Chúa Trời của mình. \q Lòng ham muốn bất trung đã ăn sâu trong chúng, \q và chúng không biết {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

sw.L: Matendo yao hayawaachi kumrudia Mungu wao, \q kwa maana roho ya ukahaba [i] ndani yao, \q na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hawamjui.
sw.B: Matendo yao hayatawaacha wamrudie Mungu wao, \q kwa sababu roho ya ukahaba iko ndani yao, \q nao hawamjui {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Matendo yao wenyewe hayatawaacha wamrudie Mungu wao. \q Tamaa ya kutokuwa waaminifu imo ndani kabisa mwao, \q nao hawamjui {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

pt.L: As obras deles não [os] deixam voltar para o seu Deus, \q porque um espírito de prostituição [está] no meio deles, \q e {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} eles não conhecem.
pt.B: As obras deles não os deixarão voltar para o seu Deus, \q porque um espírito de prostituição está neles, \q e eles não conhecem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: As próprias ações deles não os deixam voltar para o seu Deus. \q Um desejo de ser infiel está no fundo deles, \q e eles não conhecem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.

decisions.choice: their deeds do not let them return: their way of life holds them back
alternatives: they do not direct their deeds toward returning to their God
decisions.reason: "Their deeds" is probably the subject: what they keep doing has made it impossible for them to turn back. The words can also be read "they do not set their deeds toward returning", that is, they make no move to return. Both say that they do not return.

decisions.choice: a spirit of prostitution: an urge to be unfaithful
decisions.reason: As in 4:12.

decisions.choice: they do not know the LORD: they have no knowledge of God
decisions.reason: See the note on knowledge of God at 4:1. The LORD knows Ephraim (verse 3), but Ephraim does not know him.

decisions.choice: A desire to be unfaithful
decisions.reason: As in 4:12.

source.text: וְעָנָ֥ה גְאֽוֹן־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּפָנָ֑יו וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל וְאֶפְרַ֗יִם יִכָּֽשְׁלוּ֙ בַּעֲוֺנָ֔ם כָּשַׁ֥ל גַּם־יְהוּדָ֖ה עִמָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And testifies [the] pride of Israel to his face; and Israel and Ephraim stumble in their iniquity; stumbles also Judah with them.

en.L: And the pride of Israel testifies to his face; \q and Israel and Ephraim will stumble in their iniquity; \q Judah too stumbles with them.
en.B: Israel's pride testifies against him; \q Israel and Ephraim will stumble in their guilt, \q and Judah will stumble with them.
en.R: Israel's pride is a witness against them. \q Israel and Ephraim will trip and fall because of their sin, \q and Judah will fall with them.

es.L: Y el orgullo de Israel testifica en su cara; \q e Israel y Efraín tropezarán en su iniquidad; \q también Judá tropieza con ellos.
es.B: El orgullo de Israel testifica contra él; \q Israel y Efraín tropezarán en su culpa, \q y Judá tropezará con ellos.
es.R: El orgullo de Israel es testigo contra ellos. \q Israel y Efraín tropezarán y caerán por su pecado, \q y Judá caerá con ellos.

fr.L: Et l’orgueil d’Israël témoigne à sa face ; \q et Israël et Éphraïm trébucheront dans leur iniquité ; \q Juda aussi trébuche avec eux.
fr.B: L’orgueil d’Israël témoigne contre lui ; \q Israël et Éphraïm trébucheront dans leur faute, \q et Juda trébuchera avec eux.
fr.R: L’orgueil d’Israël est un témoin contre eux. \q Israël et Éphraïm trébucheront et tomberont à cause de leur péché, \q et Juda tombera avec eux.

ko.L: 이스라엘의 교만이 그의 얼굴에 대고 증언한다. \q 이스라엘과 에브라임이 자기들의 죄악 때문에 넘어지고, \q 유다도 그들과 함께 넘어진다.
ko.B: 이스라엘의 교만이 그를 고발하는 증거가 된다. \q 이스라엘과 에브라임은 자기들의 죄 때문에 넘어지고, \q 유다도 그들과 함께 넘어질 것이다.
ko.R: 이스라엘의 교만이 그들을 고발하는 증인이다. \q 이스라엘과 에브라임은 자기 죄 때문에 걸려 넘어질 것이다. \q 유다도 그들과 함께 넘어질 것이다.

vi.L: Sự kiêu ngạo của Y-sơ-ra-ên làm chứng trước mặt nó; \q Y-sơ-ra-ên và Ép-ra-im sẽ vấp ngã trong sự gian ác của chúng; \q Giu-đa cũng vấp ngã với chúng.
vi.B: Sự kiêu ngạo của Y-sơ-ra-ên làm chứng nghịch lại nó; \q Y-sơ-ra-ên và Ép-ra-im sẽ vấp ngã vì tội lỗi mình, \q và Giu-đa cũng sẽ vấp ngã với chúng.
vi.R: Sự kiêu ngạo của Y-sơ-ra-ên là bằng chứng buộc tội chúng. \q Y-sơ-ra-ên và Ép-ra-im sẽ vấp ngã vì tội lỗi của mình, \q và Giu-đa cũng sẽ ngã cùng với chúng.

sw.L: Na kiburi cha Israeli kinashuhudia mbele ya uso wake; \q na Israeli na Efraimu watajikwaa katika uovu wao; \q Yuda pia anajikwaa pamoja nao.
sw.B: Kiburi cha Israeli kinashuhudia dhidi yake; \q Israeli na Efraimu watajikwaa katika hatia yao, \q na Yuda atajikwaa pamoja nao.
sw.R: Kiburi cha Israeli ni shahidi dhidi yao. \q Israeli na Efraimu watajikwaa na kuanguka kwa sababu ya dhambi yao, \q na Yuda ataanguka pamoja nao.

pt.L: E o orgulho de Israel testemunha diante da sua face; \q e Israel e Efraim tropeçarão na sua iniquidade; \q também Judá tropeça com eles.
pt.B: O orgulho de Israel testemunha contra ele; \q Israel e Efraim tropeçarão na sua culpa, \q e Judá tropeçará com eles.
pt.R: O orgulho de Israel é uma testemunha contra eles. \q Israel e Efraim vão tropeçar e cair por causa do seu pecado, \q e Judá vai cair com eles.

decisions.choice: the pride of Israel testifies to his face: Israel's arrogance is the witness against him
alternatives: the Pride of Israel (the LORD) testifies against him
decisions.reason: "Testify to one's face" means to give evidence against someone openly (Job 16:8). Israel's proud self-reliance is the evidence that convicts it. The same words come again in 7:10. Some take "the pride of Israel" as a title of the LORD himself, as "the pride of Jacob" in Amos 8:7: then the LORD is the witness against Israel.

decisions.choice: Israel and Ephraim ... Judah: the northern kingdom, and the southern kingdom with it
decisions.reason: Israel and Ephraim name the same northern kingdom (see 4:17). Judah, warned in 4:15, will now fall with it.

decisions.choice: iniquity (Literal), guilt (Balanced), sin (Readable)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for this word ('awon), as in 4:8.

decisions.choice: against them
decisions.reason: Readable uses the plural for the nation, which the Hebrew calls "him".

decisions.choice: "iniquidad" (L); "culpa" (B); "pecado" (R)
decisions.reason: Avon at the three levels as the English has them, kept through Hosea.

decisions.choice: "iniquité" (L), "faute" (B), "péché" (R) for avon, as in 4:8
decisions.reason: Each level keeps one word for the term through Hosea, following the English iniquity / guilt / sin.

decisions.choice: *'awon* "uovu" (L); "hatia" (B); "dhambi" (R)
decisions.reason: Follows the English iniquity / guilt / sin at each level, through Hosea.

source.text: בְּצֹאנָ֣ם וּבִבְקָרָ֗ם יֵֽלְכ֛וּ לְבַקֵּ֥שׁ אֶת־יְהוָ֖ה וְלֹ֣א יִמְצָ֑אוּ חָלַ֖ץ מֵהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: With their flocks and with their herds they will go to seek Yahweh, and not they will find; he has withdrawn from them.

en.L: With their flocks and with their herds they will go to seek {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, but they will not find [{{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}]; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has withdrawn from them.
en.B: With their flocks and their herds they will go to seek {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, but they will not find {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has withdrawn from them.
en.R: They will take their sheep, goats and cattle to offer as sacrifices when they go looking for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, but they will not find {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q He has gone away from them.

es.L: Con sus rebaños y con sus vacas irán a buscar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, pero no [{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}] hallarán; \q se ha retirado de ellos.
es.B: Con sus rebaños y sus vacas irán a buscar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, pero no {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} encontrarán; \q se ha apartado de ellos.
es.R: Llevarán sus ovejas, sus cabras y su ganado para ofrecerlos en sacrificio cuando vayan a buscar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, pero no {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} encontrarán. \q Se ha ido lejos de ellos.

fr.L: Avec leurs brebis et avec leurs bœufs ils iront chercher {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, mais ils ne [{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}] trouveront pas ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} {{deity_pronoun:s’|S’}}est retiré d’eux.
fr.B: Avec leurs troupeaux de brebis et de bœufs, ils iront chercher {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, mais ils ne {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} trouveront pas ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} {{deity_pronoun:s’|S’}}est retiré loin d’eux.
fr.R: Ils prendront leurs moutons, leurs chèvres et leurs bœufs pour les offrir en sacrifice quand ils iront chercher {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, mais ils ne {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} trouveront pas. \q Il {{deity_pronoun:s’|S’}}est éloigné d’eux.

ko.L: 그들이 양 떼와 소 떼를 이끌고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찾으러 가겠지만 [그분을] 만나지 못할 것이다. \q 그분께서 그들에게서 떠나셨기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그들은 양 떼와 소 떼를 끌고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찾아가겠지만 그분을 만나지 못할 것이다. \q 그분께서 그들을 떠나 물러나셨다.
ko.R: 그들은 제물로 바칠 양과 염소와 소를 끌고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찾으러 가겠지만 그분을 만나지 못할 것이다. \q 그분께서 그들을 떠나가셨기 때문이다.

vi.L: Với bầy chiên và bầy bò của mình, chúng sẽ đi tìm kiếm {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, nhưng sẽ không tìm thấy [{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}]; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã rút lui khỏi chúng.
vi.B: Chúng sẽ đem bầy chiên và bầy bò đi tìm kiếm {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, nhưng sẽ không gặp {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã lánh xa chúng.
vi.R: Chúng sẽ đem chiên, dê và bò theo để dâng làm sinh tế khi đi tìm {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, nhưng sẽ không tìm được {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Ngài đã bỏ chúng mà đi.

sw.L: Pamoja na makundi yao ya kondoo na makundi yao ya ng'ombe watakwenda kumtafuta {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, lakini hawatamwona; \q amejitenga nao.
sw.B: Watakwenda na kondoo zao na ng'ombe zao kumtafuta {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, lakini hawatamwona; \q amejiondoa kwao.
sw.R: Watachukua kondoo, mbuzi na ng'ombe wao ili wawatoe dhabihu wanapokwenda kumtafuta {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, lakini hawatamwona. \q Ameondoka, amewaacha.

pt.L: Com os seus rebanhos e com o seu gado irão buscar {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, mas não [{{deity_pronoun:o|O}}] acharão; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se retirou deles.
pt.B: Com as suas ovelhas e o seu gado irão buscar {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, mas não {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} encontrarão; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se afastou deles.
pt.R: Eles vão levar ovelhas, cabras e bois para oferecer em sacrifício quando forem procurar {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, mas não vão encontrá-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}. \q Ele foi embora para longe deles.

decisions.choice: with their flocks and herds: bringing animals for sacrifice
decisions.reason: To "seek the LORD" with flocks and herds is to come to his shrines with sacrifices. Sacrifice without faithfulness and knowledge of God does not reach him (6:6; Amos 5:21-24; Isaiah 1:11-15).

decisions.choice: he has withdrawn from them: the LORD has pulled away from them
decisions.reason: The verb is used for taking off a sandal (Deuteronomy 25:9-10) or pulling away. The LORD has gone from them, as he says in verse 15: "I will go back to my place".

decisions.choice: sheep, goats and cattle to offer as sacrifices
decisions.reason: Readable names the animals and says why they took them (m1).

decisions.choice: The prophet speaks about God with -시- and "그분" ("그분께서 … 떠나셨다")
decisions.reason: In Hosea God's first-person speech and the prophet's words about God alternate; where God is spoken of in the third person, as here, Korean gives him the honorific, following the English deity spans.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans for "him", "he"
decisions.reason: Swahili says these with the object marker -mw- and the subject prefix a-, which take no capital.

source.text: בַּיהוָ֣ה בָּגָ֔דוּ כִּֽי־בָנִ֥ים זָרִ֖ים יָלָ֑דוּ עַתָּ֛ה יֹאכְלֵ֥ם חֹ֖דֶשׁ אֶת־חֶלְקֵיהֶֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: With Yahweh they have dealt treacherously, for children strange they have borne; now will devour them a new moon with their portions.

en.L: With {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} they have dealt treacherously, \q for they have borne strange children; \q now a new moon will devour them with their portions.
en.B: They have betrayed {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; \q the children they have borne are illegitimate. \q Now the new moon will consume them with their fields.
en.R: They have been unfaithful to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; \q they have had children who do not belong to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q Now their new moon festivals will destroy them and their land.

es.L: {{divine_name:Al SEÑOR|A Yahvé}} han traicionado, \q porque han engendrado hijos extraños; \q ahora una luna nueva los devorará con sus porciones.
es.B: Han traicionado {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}; \q los hijos que han tenido son ilegítimos. \q Ahora la luna nueva los consumirá junto con sus campos.
es.R: Han sido infieles {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}; \q han tenido hijos que no {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pertenecen. \q Ahora sus fiestas de luna nueva los destruirán a ellos y a su tierra.

fr.L: Envers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ils ont agi avec perfidie, \q car ils ont enfanté des enfants étrangers ; \q maintenant une nouvelle lune les dévorera avec leurs parts.
fr.B: Ils ont trahi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; \q les enfants qu’ils ont mis au monde sont illégitimes. \q Maintenant la nouvelle lune les dévorera avec leurs champs.
fr.R: Ils ont été infidèles {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ; \q ils ont eu des enfants qui ne {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} appartiennent pas. \q Maintenant leurs fêtes de la nouvelle lune les détruiront, eux et leur terre.

ko.L: 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 배신했다. \q 그들이 낯선 자식들을 낳았기 때문이다. \q 이제 초하루가 그들을 그들의 몫과 함께 삼킬 것이다.
ko.B: 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 배신했다. \q 그들이 낳은 자식들은 사생아들이다. \q 이제 초하루 축제가 그들과 그들의 밭을 삼켜 버릴 것이다.
ko.R: 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 신실하지 않았다. \q 그들은 그분께 속하지 않은 자식들을 낳았다. \q 이제 그들의 초하루 축제가 그들과 그들의 땅을 망하게 할 것이다.

vi.L: Chúng đã phản bội {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q vì chúng đã sinh những đứa con xa lạ; \q bây giờ một kỳ trăng mới sẽ nuốt chúng cùng với phần đất của chúng.
vi.B: Chúng đã phản bội {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; \q những đứa con chúng sinh ra là con ngoại tình. \q Bây giờ ngày trăng mới sẽ thiêu nuốt chúng cùng với ruộng đất của chúng.
vi.R: Chúng đã bất trung với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; \q chúng đã sinh ra những đứa con không thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Bây giờ chính các lễ trăng mới của chúng sẽ hủy diệt chúng và đất đai của chúng.

sw.L: Wamemtendea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa hila, \q kwa maana wamezaa watoto wageni; \q sasa mwandamo wa mwezi utawameza pamoja na mafungu yao.
sw.B: Wamemsaliti {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; \q watoto waliowazaa ni wa haramu. \q Sasa sikukuu ya mwandamo wa mwezi itawaangamiza pamoja na mashamba yao.
sw.R: Hawakuwa waaminifu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; \q wamezaa watoto ambao si {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. \q Sasa sikukuu zao za mwezi mpya zitawaangamiza wao na nchi yao.

pt.L: Com {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} agiram traiçoeiramente, \q porque geraram filhos estranhos; \q agora uma lua nova os devorará com as suas porções.
pt.B: Eles traíram {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}; \q os filhos que tiveram são ilegítimos. \q Agora a lua nova os consumirá com os seus campos.
pt.R: Eles foram infiéis {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}; \q tiveram filhos que não pertencem a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}. \q Agora as suas festas de lua nova vão destruí-los, a eles e à sua terra.

decisions.choice: dealt treacherously: broken faith, as an unfaithful spouse
decisions.reason: The verb is used for betraying a marriage or a covenant (Jeremiah 3:20; Malachi 2:14-15). It continues the picture of Israel as an unfaithful wife.

decisions.choice: strange children: children who are not the LORD's
decisions.reason: "Strange" means foreign or not one's own. In the picture of the marriage, the children are not the husband's. In plain terms, a new generation has grown up that belongs to Baal and not to the LORD, and perhaps also children born from the sexual rites of the shrines (4:13-14; 2:6).

decisions.choice: the new moon will devour them with their portions: their festivals will bring their ruin
alternatives: within a month they will be destroyed
decisions.reason: The new moon was a monthly festival day (2:13; Isaiah 1:13-14). The feasts they keep will not save them but will "eat them up", together with their portions, the fields and shares of land they hoped the festival would bless. Some take "new moon" as "month": within a month they will be destroyed. The ancient Greek translation is usually taken to read "blight" here.

decisions.choice: illegitimate children (Balanced); children who do not belong to him (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced uses the plain word for children born outside the marriage; Readable says whose children they are not (m2).

decisions.choice: fields (Balanced); land (Readable)
decisions.reason: The "portions" are their shares of land (m3).

decisions.choice: agiram traiçoeiramente (L); traíram (B); foram infiéis (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is the one for breaking faith in a marriage (m1), which Jeremiah 3:7 and 3:20 set as "trair" in Portuguese; Literal keeps the Hebrew's "with" ("com o SENHOR agiram traiçoeiramente"), and Readable says "infiéis", as the English Readable does.

records.literal_gloss: Blow [the] horn in Gibeah, [the] trumpet in Ramah; sound an alarm [at] Beth-aven: after you, Benjamin!

en.B: Blow the ram's horn in Gibeah, \q the trumpet in Ramah! \q Sound the battle cry at Beth-aven: \q "Behind you, Benjamin!"
en.R: Blow the ram's horn in Gibeah! \q Blow the trumpet in Ramah! \q Shout a warning at Beth-aven: \q "Behind you, Benjamin!"

es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Toquen|Tocad}} el cuerno de carnero en Guibeá! \q ¡{{plural_you:Toquen|Tocad}} la trompeta en Ramá! \q {{plural_you:Griten|Gritad}} la alarma en Bet-avén: \q «¡Detrás de ti, Benjamín!».

fr.R: Sonnez du cor à Guibea ! \q Sonnez de la trompette à Rama ! \q Donnez l’alerte à Beth-Aven : \q « Derrière toi, Benjamin ! »

ko.L: 기브아에서 숫양 뿔 나팔을 불어라. \q 라마에서 나팔을 불어라. \q 벧아웬에서 경보를 울려라. \q "베냐민아, 네 뒤에!"
ko.B: 기브아에서 숫양 뿔 나팔을 불어라. \q 라마에서 나팔을 불어라! \q 벧아웬에서 싸움의 함성을 질러라. \q "베냐민아, 뒤를 조심하여라!"
ko.R: 기브아에서 숫양 뿔 나팔을 불어라! \q 라마에서 나팔을 불어라! \q 벧아웬에서 위험을 알려라. \q "베냐민아, 적이 뒤에 있다!"

vi.L: Hãy thổi tù và tại Ghi-bê-a, \q thổi kèn tại Ra-ma; \q hãy báo động tại Bết-A-ven: \q "Phía sau ngươi, hỡi Bên-gia-min!"
vi.B: Hãy thổi tù và tại Ghi-bê-a, \q thổi kèn tại Ra-ma! \q Hãy hô tiếng xung trận tại Bết-A-ven: \q "Hỡi Bên-gia-min, phía sau ngươi kìa!"
vi.R: Hãy thổi tù và tại Ghi-bê-a! \q Hãy thổi kèn tại Ra-ma! \q Hãy la lên cảnh báo tại Bết-A-ven: \q "Hỡi Bên-gia-min, coi chừng phía sau!"

sw.L: Pigeni baragumu huko Gibea, \q tarumbeta huko Rama; \q pigeni kelele ya hatari huko Beth-aveni: \q "Nyuma yako, Benyamini!"
sw.B: Pigeni baragumu huko Gibea, \q tarumbeta huko Rama! \q Pigeni kelele ya vita huko Beth-aveni: \q "Nyuma yako, Benyamini!"
sw.R: Pigeni baragumu huko Gibea! \q Pigeni tarumbeta huko Rama! \q Pigeni kelele ya tahadhari huko Beth-aveni: \q "Nyuma yako, Benyamini!"

pt.L: Toquem o chifre de carneiro em Gibeá, \q a trombeta em Ramá; \q deem o alarme em Bete-Áven: \q "Atrás de você, Benjamim!"
pt.B: Toquem o chifre de carneiro em Gibeá, \q a trombeta em Ramá! \q Deem o grito de guerra em Bete-Áven: \q "Atrás de você, Benjamim!"
pt.R: Toquem o chifre de carneiro em Gibeá! \q Toquem a trombeta em Ramá! \q Gritem um aviso em Bete-Áven: \q "Atrás de você, Benjamim!"

decisions.choice: horn and trumpet in Gibeah and Ramah: the alarm of war in the towns of Benjamin
decisions.reason: The ram's horn and the metal trumpet were blown to warn of an attacking army (Jeremiah 4:5; Joel 2:1). Gibeah and Ramah were towns of Benjamin on the road north of Jerusalem, on the border between Judah and Israel, and Beth-aven (Bethel) lay just beyond. The alarm runs from south to north. The verses that follow (8-14) are often linked with the war of about 734-732 BC, when Israel and Aram attacked Judah and Judah turned to Assyria (2 Kings 16:5-9; Isaiah 7), but the text does not name the occasion.

decisions.choice: Beth-aven: Bethel, called by Hosea's mocking name
decisions.reason: See the note at 4:15.

decisions.choice: Behind you, Benjamin!: a battle cry
alternatives: we follow you, Benjamin (a rallying cry)
decisions.reason: The same words are a battle cry in Judges 5:14 ("after you, Benjamin"), meaning "we follow you". Here it is more likely a warning: the enemy is right behind you.

decisions.choice: ram's horn ... trumpet
decisions.reason: Elsewhere Literal and Readable may say "trumpet" for the ram's horn (shofar). Here it stands beside the metal trumpet, so every level says "ram's horn" to keep the two instruments distinct.

decisions.choice: Sound the battle cry (Balanced); Shout a warning (Readable)
decisions.reason: The verb means to raise a loud shout, the war cry or alarm (Numbers 10:9; Joel 2:1).

decisions.choice: Behind you, Benjamin!
decisions.reason: Every level keeps the short cry, which in English, as in Hebrew, can be a warning or a call to follow (m3).

decisions.choice: "cuerno de carnero" ... "trompeta"
decisions.reason: Beside the metal trumpet the shofar is "cuerno de carnero" at every level, as the terms note sets for this verse.

decisions.choice: "Guibeá", "Ramá", "Bet-avén", "Benjamín"
decisions.reason: The published Spanish forms.

decisions.choice: "le cor" for the shofar at Readable too, beside "la trompette"
decisions.reason: Readable usually says "trompette" for the shofar, but here it stands beside the metal trumpet, so every level keeps the two instruments apart, as the English "ram's horn" does.

decisions.choice: "숫양 뿔 나팔" for the *shofar* beside "나팔" for the metal trumpet, at every level
decisions.reason: Where the ram's horn stands beside a metal trumpet, Korean names both instruments, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "tù và" (shofar); "kèn" (the metal trumpet)
decisions.reason: Beside a metal trumpet the shofar is "tù và" at every level, as the English has "ram's horn"; the Isaiah note's "tù và" for the shofar and "kèn" for the trumpet keep the two instruments apart.

decisions.choice: *shofar* "baragumu", *chatsotserah* "tarumbeta"
decisions.reason: The ram's horn is "baragumu" at every level, as Isaiah and Jeremiah, and the metal trumpet beside it "tarumbeta", so the two instruments stay apart.

decisions.choice: o chifre de carneiro ... a trombeta (every level); Gibeá, Ramá
alternatives: a trombeta de chifre ... a trombeta
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also 8:1). The ram's horn stands beside the metal trumpet, so every level keeps them apart, as the English does (r-en-1): "o chifre de carneiro", the Portuguese the Old Testament gives the shofar at Literal and Balanced (Exodus 19:13; Jeremiah 4:5), and "a trombeta", the metal trumpet of Numbers 10:2. Readable says "chifre de carneiro" where the English Readable says "ram's horn", as here, and "trombeta" where it says "trumpet". The towns of Benjamin take the forms Judges 19 gives them in Portuguese, "Gibeá" and "Ramá".

decisions.choice: Atrás de você, Benjamim!
decisions.reason: The cry is the people's, shouted to the tribe as to one man, so it takes "você", the form people use to each other; "tu" is kept for God's own address.

source.text: אֶפְרַ֨יִם֙ לְשַׁמָּ֣ה תִֽהְיֶ֔ה בְּי֖וֹם תּֽוֹכֵחָ֑ה בְּשִׁבְטֵי֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הוֹדַ֖עְתִּי נֶאֱמָנָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Ephraim a desolation will become in [the] day of rebuke; among [the] tribes of Israel I make known [what is] sure.

en.L: Ephraim will become a desolation on the day of rebuke; \q among the tribes of Israel I make known what is sure.
en.B: Ephraim will be laid waste on the day of punishment; \q among the tribes of Israel I declare what will surely come.
en.R: Ephraim will be ruined on the day I punish him. \q I am telling the tribes of Israel what will surely happen.

es.L: Efraín será una desolación en el día del castigo; \q entre las tribus de Israel doy a conocer lo que es seguro.
es.B: Efraín quedará arrasado en el día del castigo; \q entre las tribus de Israel anuncio lo que sin duda sucederá.
es.R: Efraín quedará en ruinas el día en que lo castigue. \q Les digo a las tribus de Israel lo que sin duda va a pasar.

fr.L: Éphraïm deviendra une désolation au jour de la réprimande ; \q parmi les tribus d’Israël je fais connaître ce qui est certain.
fr.B: Éphraïm sera dévasté au jour du châtiment ; \q parmi les tribus d’Israël j’annonce ce qui arrivera sûrement.
fr.R: Éphraïm sera ruiné le jour où je le punirai. \q Je dis aux tribus d’Israël ce qui va sûrement arriver.

ko.L: 에브라임은 책망의 날에 황폐하게 될 것이다. \q 이스라엘 지파들 가운데 내가 확실한 일을 알린다.
ko.B: 에브라임은 벌을 받는 날에 황무지가 될 것이다. \q 나는 이스라엘 지파들에게 반드시 일어날 일을 선포한다.
ko.R: 내가 에브라임을 벌하는 날, 에브라임은 폐허가 될 것이다. \q 나는 이스라엘 지파들에게 반드시 일어날 일을 알려 준다.

vi.L: Ép-ra-im sẽ trở nên hoang tàn trong ngày quở phạt; \q giữa các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cho biết điều chắc chắn.
vi.B: Ép-ra-im sẽ bị tàn phá trong ngày trừng phạt; \q giữa các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} công bố điều chắc chắn sẽ xảy đến.
vi.R: Ép-ra-im sẽ bị tàn phá vào ngày {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trừng phạt nó. \q Ta đang cho các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên biết điều chắc chắn sẽ xảy ra.

sw.L: Efraimu atakuwa ukiwa katika siku ya kukemewa; \q kati ya makabila ya Israeli ninajulisha [jambo] lililo hakika.
sw.B: Efraimu ataharibiwa siku ya adhabu; \q kati ya makabila ya Israeli ninatangaza yale yatakayotokea kwa hakika.
sw.R: Efraimu ataangamizwa siku nitakapomwadhibu. \q Ninayaambia makabila ya Israeli mambo yatakayotokea kwa hakika.

pt.L: Efraim se tornará uma desolação no dia da repreensão; \q entre as tribos de Israel faço conhecer o [que é] certo.
pt.B: Efraim será arrasado no dia do castigo; \q entre as tribos de Israel anuncio o que certamente virá.
pt.R: Efraim vai ficar arruinado no dia em que eu o castigar. \q Estou dizendo às tribos de Israel o que vai acontecer com certeza.

decisions.choice: the day of rebuke: the day the LORD calls Ephraim to account
decisions.reason: The word is used for a rebuke or reproof, and here for the punishment that carries it out (2 Kings 19:3).

decisions.choice: I make known what is sure: I announce what will certainly happen
decisions.reason: The word means what is firm, reliable or lasting. The LORD's announcement of judgment is not a threat that may fail; it will come to pass.

decisions.choice: the day I punish him
decisions.reason: Readable says whose rebuke it is (m1).

source.text: הָיוּ֙ שָׂרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה כְּמַסִּיגֵ֖י גְּב֑וּל עֲלֵיהֶ֕ם אֶשְׁפּ֥וֹךְ כַּמַּ֖יִם עֶבְרָתִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Have become [the] leaders of Judah like movers of a boundary; on them I will pour out like water my wrath.

en.L: The leaders of Judah have become like those who move a boundary; \q on them I will pour out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} wrath like water.
en.B: The leaders of Judah have become like those who move boundary stones; \q I will pour out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} wrath on them like water.
en.R: The leaders of Judah are like people who move boundary stones to take a neighbor's land. \q I will pour out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger on them like water.

es.L: Los príncipes de Judá se han vuelto como los que mueven un lindero; \q sobre ellos derramaré como agua {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} furor.
es.B: Los jefes de Judá se han vuelto como los que mueven los mojones; \q derramaré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} furor sobre ellos como agua.
es.R: Los dirigentes de Judá son como los que mueven los mojones para quedarse con la tierra del vecino. \q Derramaré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} enojo sobre ellos como agua.

fr.L: Les chefs de Juda sont devenus comme ceux qui déplacent une borne ; \q sur eux je répandrai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} fureur comme de l’eau.
fr.B: Les chefs de Juda sont devenus comme ceux qui déplacent les bornes ; \q je répandrai sur eux {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} fureur comme de l’eau.
fr.R: Les dirigeants de Juda sont comme des gens qui déplacent les bornes pour prendre la terre de leur voisin. \q Je répandrai sur eux {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère comme de l’eau.

ko.L: 유다의 고관들은 경계를 옮기는 자들처럼 되었다. \q 내가 그들 위에 내 진노를 물처럼 쏟아붓겠다.
ko.B: 유다의 지도자들은 경계석을 옮기는 자들처럼 되었다. \q 내가 그들에게 내 진노를 물처럼 쏟아붓겠다.
ko.R: 유다의 지도자들은 이웃의 땅을 빼앗으려고 경계석을 옮기는 사람들과 같다. \q 나는 그들에게 내 분노를 물처럼 쏟아붓겠다.

vi.L: Các quan chức Giu-đa đã trở nên như những kẻ dời mốc ranh giới; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đổ cơn thịnh nộ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trên chúng như nước.
vi.B: Các quan chức Giu-đa đã trở nên như những kẻ dời cột mốc ranh giới; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đổ cơn thịnh nộ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trên chúng như nước đổ.
vi.R: Các nhà lãnh đạo Giu-đa giống như những kẻ dời cột mốc ranh giới để chiếm đất của người lân cận. \q Ta sẽ trút cơn giận của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trên chúng như nước.

sw.L: Viongozi wa Yuda wamekuwa kama wale wanaosogeza mpaka; \q juu yao nitaimwaga ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} kama maji.
sw.B: Viongozi wa Yuda wamekuwa kama wanaohamisha mawe ya mipaka; \q nitaimwaga ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} juu yao kama maji.
sw.R: Viongozi wa Yuda ni kama watu wanaohamisha mawe ya mipaka ili wachukue ardhi ya jirani. \q Nitaimwaga hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} juu yao kama maji.

pt.L: Os líderes de Judá se tornaram como os que mudam um marco; \q sobre eles derramarei como água a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} ira.
pt.B: Os líderes de Judá se tornaram como os que mudam os marcos de divisa; \q derramarei sobre eles a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} ira como água.
pt.R: Os líderes de Judá são como pessoas que mudam os marcos de divisa para tomar a terra do vizinho. \q Vou derramar sobre eles a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} ira como água.

decisions.choice: those who move a boundary: people who steal land
alternatives: they overstep the limits set by the covenant
decisions.reason: The law cursed anyone who moved a neighbor's boundary stone to take his land (Deuteronomy 19:14; 27:17; Proverbs 22:28). Judah's leaders are like such thieves. If the setting is the war of verse 8, they may have seized the border land of Benjamin while Israel was weak; or the words may mean that they set aside the old limits of the covenant.

decisions.choice: pour out my wrath like water: a judgment that floods over them
decisions.reason: Wrath poured out like water is anger that cannot be held back or gathered up again (Psalm 79:6; Ezekiel 7:8).

decisions.choice: to take a neighbor's land
decisions.reason: Readable says why anyone would move a boundary stone (m1).

decisions.choice: "príncipes" (L); "jefes" (B); "dirigentes" (R)
decisions.reason: Sarim with the three words the Spanish prophets use, as the terms note sets (the English has "leaders").

decisions.choice: "furor" (L, B); "enojo" (R)
decisions.reason: Wrath as the terms note sets for these books.

decisions.choice: sarim "les chefs" (L, B), "les dirigeants" (R); God's wrath "fureur" (L, B), "colère" (R)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet sets for the Twelve and Ezekiel.

decisions.choice: *sarim* "고관" (L), "지도자" (B, R) here; "진노" (L, B), "분노" (R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet gives 고관 / 관리 / 지도자 for *sarim*; in this verse the English Balanced says "leaders", so Balanced follows it. Wrath is 진노 / 진노 / 분노.

decisions.choice: "các quan chức" (L, B); "các nhà lãnh đạo" (R) for sarim
decisions.reason: The Twelve's rule for sar ("officials" / "leaders"), used through Hosea; "thủ lĩnh" is kept for nasi' and the angels of Daniel.

source.text: עָשׁ֥וּק אֶפְרַ֖יִם רְצ֣וּץ מִשְׁפָּ֑ט כִּ֣י הוֹאִ֔יל הָלַ֖ךְ אַחֲרֵי־צָֽו׃

records.literal_gloss: Oppressed [is] Ephraim, crushed [in] judgment, for he was determined, he walked after command.

en.L: Ephraim [is] oppressed, crushed in judgment, \q for he was determined to walk after [the] command.
en.B: Ephraim is oppressed, crushed under judgment, \q because he was determined to follow mere commands.
en.R: Ephraim is oppressed and crushed by judgment, \q because he chose to follow commands that did not come from God.

es.L: Efraín [está] oprimido, quebrantado en juicio, \q porque se empeñó en andar tras [el] mandato.
es.B: Efraín está oprimido, aplastado por el juicio, \q porque se empeñó en seguir mandatos humanos.
es.R: Efraín está oprimido y aplastado por el juicio, \q porque decidió seguir mandatos que no venían de Dios.

fr.L: Éphraïm [est] opprimé, écrasé par le jugement, \q car il s’est obstiné à marcher après [le] commandement.
fr.B: Éphraïm est opprimé, écrasé par le jugement, \q parce qu’il s’est obstiné à suivre de simples préceptes humains.
fr.R: Éphraïm est opprimé et écrasé par le jugement, \q parce qu’il a choisi de suivre des ordres qui ne venaient pas de Dieu.

ko.L: 에브라임은 억압을 당하고 심판으로 짓밟혔다. \q 그가 굳이 명령을 따라 걸었기 때문이다.
ko.B: 에브라임은 억눌리고 심판으로 짓밟혔다. \q 그가 헛된 명령을 굳이 따랐기 때문이다.
ko.R: 에브라임은 억눌리고 심판으로 짓밟혔다. \q 그가 하나님에게서 오지 않은 명령을 따르기로 했기 때문이다.

vi.L: Ép-ra-im bị áp bức, bị nghiền nát trong sự phán xét, \q vì nó đã quyết tâm đi theo mệnh lệnh.
vi.B: Ép-ra-im bị áp bức, bị nghiền nát dưới sự phán xét, \q vì nó đã quyết đi theo những mệnh lệnh hư không.
vi.R: Ép-ra-im bị áp bức và bị nghiền nát bởi sự phán xét, \q vì nó đã chọn đi theo những mệnh lệnh không đến từ Đức Chúa Trời.

sw.L: Efraimu ameonewa, amepondwa katika hukumu, \q kwa maana alikusudia kufuata amri.
sw.B: Efraimu anaonewa, amepondwa chini ya hukumu, \q kwa sababu aliamua kufuata amri tupu.
sw.R: Efraimu ameonewa na kupondwa na hukumu, \q kwa sababu alichagua kufuata amri ambazo hazikutoka kwa Mungu.

pt.L: Efraim [está] oprimido, esmagado no julgamento, \q porque resolveu andar atrás do mandamento.
pt.B: Efraim está oprimido, esmagado pelo julgamento, \q porque resolveu seguir meras ordens humanas.
pt.R: Efraim está oprimido e esmagado pelo julgamento, \q porque escolheu seguir ordens que não vinham de Deus.

decisions.choice: oppressed, crushed in judgment: Ephraim suffers under the LORD's judgment
decisions.reason: "Oppressed" and "crushed" are the words of the covenant curse in Deuteronomy 28:33. Ephraim is crushed by the judgment the LORD brings. The ancient Greek translation is usually taken to read the two words as active, "Ephraim oppressed his opponent, he trampled justice", which would make them a further charge rather than a punishment.

decisions.choice: command: probably human commands followed instead of the LORD's
decisions.reason: The word (tsav) is rare and its sense here is uncertain. Read as "command", it may point to the commands of Israel's kings about worship, such as Jeroboam's calves (1 Kings 12:28-33), followed in place of the LORD's instruction. With a small change it could be "filth" or "worthlessness", that is, idols; the ancient Greek translation is usually taken to read "worthless things". Isaiah 28:10, 13 use the same short word in mimicking babble.

decisions.choice: mere commands (Balanced); commands that did not come from God (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make plain that the commands were not the LORD's, which is the likely point (m2). Because the word is uncertain, the expansion is marked uncertain.

decisions.choice: "하나님에게서 오지 않은 명령" (R), with "에게서" rather than "께로부터"
decisions.reason: God is speaking; in his own mouth "하나님" takes no honorific particle.

records.literal_gloss: And I [am] like a moth to Ephraim, and like rot to [the] house of Judah.

en.L: And I [am] like a moth to Ephraim, \q and like rot to the house of Judah.
en.B: I am like a moth to Ephraim, \q like rot to the house of Judah.
en.R: I am like a moth eating away at Ephraim, \q like rot eating away at the people of Judah.

es.L: Y yo [soy] como polilla para Efraín, \q y como podredumbre para la casa de Judá.
es.B: Yo soy como polilla para Efraín, \q como podredumbre para la casa de Judá.
es.R: Soy como una polilla que va carcomiendo a Efraín, \q como la podredumbre que va carcomiendo al pueblo de Judá.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, [je suis] comme la teigne pour Éphraïm, \q et comme la pourriture pour la maison de Juda.
fr.B: Je suis comme la teigne pour Éphraïm, \q comme la pourriture pour la maison de Juda.
fr.R: Je suis comme une mite qui ronge Éphraïm, \q comme la pourriture qui ronge le peuple de Juda.

ko.L: 나는 에브라임에게 좀과 같고, \q 유다 집에게는 썩음과 같다.
ko.B: 나는 에브라임에게 좀과 같고, \q 유다 집에게는 썩게 하는 것과 같다.
ko.R: 나는 에브라임을 갉아 먹는 좀과 같고, \q 유다 백성을 썩게 하는 부패와 같다.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [như] con mọt đối với Ép-ra-im, \q và như sự mục nát đối với nhà Giu-đa.
vi.B: Ta như con mọt đối với Ép-ra-im, \q như sự mục nát đối với nhà Giu-đa.
vi.R: Ta như con mọt gặm nhấm Ép-ra-im, \q như sự mục nát ăn mòn dân Giu-đa.

sw.L: Nami [ni] kama nondo kwa Efraimu, \q na kama uozo kwa nyumba ya Yuda.
sw.B: Mimi ni kama nondo kwa Efraimu, \q kama uozo kwa nyumba ya Yuda.
sw.R: Mimi ni kama nondo anayemla Efraimu polepole, \q kama uozo unaowala watu wa Yuda polepole.

pt.L: E eu [sou] como a traça para Efraim, \q e como a podridão para a casa de Judá.
pt.B: Eu sou como a traça para Efraim, \q como a podridão para a casa de Judá.
pt.R: Eu sou como a traça que vai roendo Efraim, \q como a podridão que vai corroendo o povo de Judá.

decisions.choice: a moth ... rot: a slow decay that eats away from within
alternatives: pus: a festering sore (taking the first word in another sense, to match the sores of verse 13)
decisions.reason: The moth eats cloth (Isaiah 50:9; 51:8; Job 13:28), and rot eats wood or bone (Proverbs 12:4; 14:30). The LORD's judgment will work quietly and surely, wearing the two kingdoms away. Verse 14 turns to the sudden attack of a lion.

decisions.choice: eating away at ... the people of Judah
decisions.reason: Readable says what the moth and rot do (m1), and says "people" for "house".

source.text: וַיַּ֨רְא אֶפְרַ֜יִם אֶת־חָלְי֗וֹ וִֽיהוּדָה֙ אֶת־מְזֹר֔וֹ וַיֵּ֤לֶךְ אֶפְרַ֨יִם֙ אֶל־אַשּׁ֔וּר וַיִּשְׁלַ֖ח אֶל־מֶ֣לֶךְ יָרֵ֑ב וְה֗וּא לֹ֤א יוּכַל֙ לִרְפֹּ֣א לָכֶ֔ם וְלֹֽא־יִגְהֶ֥ה מִכֶּ֖ם מָזֽוֹר׃

records.literal_gloss: And saw Ephraim his sickness, and Judah his sore; and went Ephraim to Assyria, and sent to [the] great king; and he not is able to heal you, and not will depart from you [the] sore.

en.L: And Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah his sore; \q and Ephraim went to Assyria \q and sent to the great king; \q but he is not able to heal you, \q and the sore will not go away from you.
en.B: When Ephraim saw his sickness and Judah his wound, \q Ephraim went to Assyria \q and sent to the great king. \q But he cannot heal you, \q and your wound will not go away.
en.R: When Ephraim saw how sick he was, and Judah saw his wound, \q Ephraim went to Assyria \q and asked the great king for help. \q But that king cannot heal you \q or cure your wound.

es.L: Y vio Efraín su enfermedad, y Judá su llaga; \q y fue Efraín a Asiria \q y envió [mensajeros] al gran rey; \q pero él no puede {{plural_you:sanarlos|sanaros}}, \q ni {{plural_you:se les quitará|se os quitará}} la llaga.
es.B: Cuando Efraín vio su enfermedad y Judá su herida, \q Efraín fue a Asiria \q y envió [mensajeros] al gran rey. \q Pero él no puede {{plural_you:sanarlos|sanaros}}, \q y {{plural_you:su herida|vuestra herida}} no se curará.
es.R: Cuando Efraín vio lo enfermo que estaba, y Judá vio su herida, \q Efraín fue a Asiria \q y le pidió ayuda al gran rey. \q Pero ese rey no puede {{plural_you:sanarlos|sanaros}} \q ni curar {{plural_you:su herida|vuestra herida}}.

fr.L: Et Éphraïm a vu sa maladie, et Juda sa plaie ; \q et Éphraïm est allé vers l’Assyrie \q et a envoyé [des messagers] au grand roi ; \q mais lui ne peut pas vous guérir, \q et la plaie ne s’en ira pas de vous.
fr.B: Quand Éphraïm a vu sa maladie, et Juda sa blessure, \q Éphraïm est allé vers l’Assyrie \q et s’est adressé au grand roi. \q Mais celui-ci ne peut pas vous guérir, \q et votre blessure ne disparaîtra pas.
fr.R: Quand Éphraïm a vu combien il était malade, et Juda sa blessure, \q Éphraïm est allé en Assyrie \q et il a demandé de l’aide au grand roi. \q Mais ce roi ne peut pas vous guérir \q ni soigner votre blessure.

ko.L: 에브라임이 자기 병을 보고, 유다가 자기 상처를 보았다. \q 그래서 에브라임은 앗시리아로 가서 \q 큰 왕에게 [사람을] 보냈다. \q 그러나 그는 너희를 고칠 수 없고, \q 너희에게서 상처를 낫게 하지 못할 것이다.
ko.B: 에브라임이 자기 병든 것을 보고 유다가 자기 상처를 보았을 때, \q 에브라임은 앗시리아로 가서 \q 대왕에게 사람을 보냈다. \q 그러나 그는 너희를 고칠 수 없고, \q 너희 상처는 낫지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 에브라임은 자기가 얼마나 병들었는지 보았고, 유다는 자기 상처를 보았다. 그러자 \q 에브라임은 앗시리아로 가서 \q 대왕에게 도와 달라고 했다. \q 그러나 그 왕은 너희를 고칠 수 없고, \q 너희 상처를 낫게 할 수도 없다.

vi.L: Ép-ra-im thấy bệnh tật mình, và Giu-đa [thấy] vết thương mình; \q Ép-ra-im đi đến A-si-ri \q và sai [người] đến cùng vị vua lớn; \q nhưng vua ấy không thể chữa lành các ngươi, \q và vết thương sẽ không rời khỏi các ngươi.
vi.B: Khi Ép-ra-im thấy bệnh tật mình và Giu-đa thấy vết thương mình, \q Ép-ra-im đã đi đến A-si-ri \q và sai người đến cùng đại vương. \q Nhưng vua ấy không thể chữa lành các ngươi, \q và vết thương của các ngươi sẽ không lành.
vi.R: Khi Ép-ra-im thấy mình bệnh nặng, và Giu-đa thấy vết thương của mình, \q Ép-ra-im đã đi đến A-si-ri \q và cầu cứu vị đại vương. \q Nhưng vua ấy không thể chữa lành các ngươi \q hay chữa khỏi vết thương của các ngươi.

sw.L: Na Efraimu akaona ugonjwa wake, na Yuda kidonda chake; \q naye Efraimu akaenda Ashuru, \q akatuma kwa mfalme mkuu; \q lakini yeye hawezi kuwaponya ninyi, \q wala kidonda hakitawaondoka.
sw.B: Efraimu alipoona ugonjwa wake, na Yuda kidonda chake, \q Efraimu alikwenda Ashuru \q akatuma ujumbe kwa mfalme mkuu. \q Lakini yeye hawezi kuwaponya, \q wala kidonda chenu hakitapona.
sw.R: Efraimu alipoona jinsi alivyokuwa mgonjwa, na Yuda alipoona kidonda chake, \q Efraimu alikwenda Ashuru \q akamwomba mfalme mkuu msaada. \q Lakini mfalme huyo hawezi kuwaponya \q wala kukiponya kidonda chenu.

pt.L: E Efraim viu a sua doença, e Judá a sua chaga; \q e Efraim foi à Assíria \q e mandou [mensageiros] ao grande rei; \q mas ele não pode curar vocês, \q e a chaga não sairá de vocês.
pt.B: Quando Efraim viu a sua doença e Judá a sua ferida, \q Efraim foi à Assíria \q e mandou mensageiros ao grande rei. \q Mas ele não pode curar vocês, \q e a ferida de vocês não sarará.
pt.R: Quando Efraim viu como estava doente, e Judá viu a sua ferida, \q Efraim foi à Assíria \q e pediu ajuda ao grande rei. \q Mas esse rei não pode curar vocês \q nem sarar a ferida de vocês.

decisions.choice: the great king: the king of Assyria
alternatives: a king who will contend (for them)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads as if it were "King Jareb" (or "a contentious king"), but no Assyrian king had such a name. Divided differently, the same letters give "the great king", a standard title of the Assyrian kings (2 Kings 18:19, 28). The same phrase returns in 10:6.

decisions.choice: Ephraim went to Assyria: Israel sought Assyria's help
decisions.reason: Israel's kings paid tribute to Assyria and sought its favor: Menahem paid Tiglath-pileser a thousand talents of silver (2 Kings 15:19-20), and Hoshea first submitted to Shalmaneser (2 Kings 17:3). Judah's king Ahaz also sent to Tiglath-pileser for help (2 Kings 16:7-8), and the verse names Judah's wound alongside Ephraim's. Hosea mocks the turning to Assyria again in 7:11; 8:9; 12:2.

decisions.choice: sickness ... sore: the nation's wounds pictured as disease
decisions.reason: The kingdoms are pictured as sick bodies. The second word (mazor) is a wound or sore that will not close (Jeremiah 30:12-13). Assyria, which they went to for a cure, cannot heal it; only the LORD can (6:1; 14:5).

decisions.choice: you: Ephraim and Judah addressed directly
decisions.reason: The verse turns from "he" to "you" (plural), speaking straight to both kingdoms.

decisions.choice: wound (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal says "sore"; Balanced and Readable say "wound", the more usual word for a hurt that needs healing.

decisions.choice: asked the great king for help ... that king
decisions.reason: Readable says why Ephraim sent to the king and makes plain whom "he" refers to.

decisions.choice: "[[sanarlos|sanaros]]", "[[su herida|vuestra herida]]"
decisions.reason: Ephraim and Judah are addressed together, and the Hebrew "you" is plural, so it takes the plural_you span.

decisions.choice: "앗시리아"; "큰 왕" (L), "대왕" (B, R)
decisions.reason: 앗시리아 for the empire, never 앗수르, as the published Kings; "the great king" is a title of the Assyrian king, which the shared footnote explains.

decisions.choice: vocês (Ephraim and Judah together)
decisions.reason: The verse turns from "he" to a plural "you" for both kingdoms (m4), so Portuguese says "vocês". Literal brackets "mensageiros", which Portuguese "mandou" needs and the Hebrew leaves out.

source.text: כִּ֣י אָנֹכִ֤י כַשַּׁ֨חַל֙ לְאֶפְרַ֔יִם וְכַכְּפִ֖יר לְבֵ֣ית יְהוּדָ֑ה אֲנִ֨י אֲנִ֤י אֶטְרֹף֙ וְאֵלֵ֔ךְ אֶשָּׂ֖א וְאֵ֥ין מַצִּֽיל׃

records.literal_gloss: For I [am] like the lion to Ephraim, and like the young lion to [the] house of Judah; I, I will tear and go; I will carry off, and there is no deliverer.

en.L: For I [will be] like the lion to Ephraim, \q and like the young lion to the house of Judah; \q I, I will tear and go; \q I will carry off, and none will rescue.
en.B: For I will be like a lion to Ephraim, \q like a young lion to the house of Judah. \q I, yes I, will tear them to pieces and go away; \q I will carry them off, and no one will rescue them.
en.R: I will be like a lion to Ephraim, \q like a strong young lion to the people of Judah. \q I myself will tear them to pieces and walk away. \q I will carry them off, and no one will be able to save them.

es.L: Porque yo [seré] como el león para Efraín, \q y como el leoncillo para la casa de Judá; \q yo, yo desgarraré y me iré; \q me llevaré [la presa], y no habrá quien libre.
es.B: Porque seré como un león para Efraín, \q como un león joven para la casa de Judá. \q Yo, sí, yo, los despedazaré y me iré; \q me los llevaré, y nadie los rescatará.
es.R: Seré como un león para Efraín, \q como un león joven y fuerte para el pueblo de Judá. \q Yo mismo los despedazaré y me iré. \q Me los llevaré, y nadie podrá salvarlos.

fr.L: Car {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, [je serai] comme le lion pour Éphraïm, \q et comme le jeune lion pour la maison de Juda ; \q {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, je déchirerai et je {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}en irai ; \q j’emporterai, et personne ne délivrera.
fr.B: Car je serai comme un lion pour Éphraïm, \q comme un jeune lion pour la maison de Juda. \q Moi, oui {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, je les mettrai en pièces et je {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}en irai ; \q je les emporterai, et personne ne les délivrera.
fr.R: Je serai comme un lion pour Éphraïm, \q comme un jeune lion plein de force pour le peuple de Juda. \q Moi-même, je les mettrai en pièces et je {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}en irai. \q Je les emporterai, et personne ne pourra les sauver.

ko.L: 나는 에브라임에게 사자와 같고, \q 유다 집에게 젊은 사자와 같을 것이다. \q 내가, 바로 내가 찢고 갈 것이다. \q 내가 물어 가도 건져 낼 자가 없을 것이다.
ko.B: 나는 에브라임에게 사자처럼, \q 유다 집에게 젊은 사자처럼 되겠다. \q 내가, 바로 내가 그들을 찢고 떠나가겠다. \q 내가 그들을 물어 가도 구해 낼 자가 없을 것이다.
ko.R: 나는 에브라임에게 사자처럼 되고, \q 유다 백성에게 힘센 젊은 사자처럼 되겠다. \q 나 자신이 그들을 갈기갈기 찢고 가 버리겠다. \q 내가 그들을 물어 가도 아무도 구해 내지 못할 것이다.

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [sẽ] như sư tử đối với Ép-ra-im, \q và như sư tử tơ đối với nhà Giu-đa; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ xé rồi đi; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ tha đi, và không ai giải cứu.
vi.B: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ như sư tử đối với Ép-ra-im, \q như sư tử tơ đối với nhà Giu-đa. \q Ta, phải, chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ xé chúng ra từng mảnh rồi bỏ đi; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ tha chúng đi, và không ai giải cứu được.
vi.R: Ta sẽ như sư tử đối với Ép-ra-im, \q như sư tử tơ dũng mãnh đối với dân Giu-đa. \q Chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ xé chúng ra từng mảnh rồi bỏ đi. \q Ta sẽ tha chúng đi, và không ai có thể cứu chúng.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [nitakuwa] kama simba kwa Efraimu, \q na kama mwana-simba kwa nyumba ya Yuda; \q {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} nitararua na kwenda {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}; \q nitachukua, wala hapana atakayeokoa.
sw.B: Kwa maana nitakuwa kama simba kwa Efraimu, \q kama mwana-simba kwa nyumba ya Yuda. \q Mimi, naam {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, nitawararua vipande vipande na kwenda {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}; \q nitawachukua, wala hakuna atakayewaokoa.
sw.R: Nitakuwa kama simba kwa Efraimu, \q kama mwana-simba mwenye nguvu kwa watu wa Yuda. \q Mimi {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} nitawararua vipande vipande na kuondoka. \q Nitawachukua, wala hakuna atakayeweza kuwaokoa.

pt.L: Pois eu [serei] como o leão para Efraim, \q e como o leão novo para a casa de Judá; \q eu, eu despedaçarei e irei embora; \q levarei, e não haverá quem livre.
pt.B: Pois serei como um leão para Efraim, \q como um leão novo para a casa de Judá. \q Eu, sim, eu os despedaçarei e irei embora; \q eu os levarei, e ninguém os livrará.
pt.R: Vou ser como um leão para Efraim, \q como um leão jovem e forte para o povo de Judá. \q Eu mesmo vou despedaçá-los e ir embora. \q Vou levá-los, e ninguém vai conseguir salvá-los.

decisions.choice: a lion ... a young lion: two words for a lion in full strength
decisions.reason: The two words are used in parallel for the lion (Job 4:10; Psalm 91:13); the second is a young lion old enough to hunt. The picture is of a sudden, violent attack, set against the slow decay of verse 12 (compare 13:7-8; Amos 3:12).

decisions.choice: I, I: the LORD himself, not Assyria
decisions.reason: The pronoun is doubled for emphasis. The kingdoms turned to Assyria for help (verse 13), but the one who tears them is the LORD himself, and no one, Assyria included, can rescue them from him.

decisions.choice: tear, go away, carry off, no one to rescue: the lion seizing its prey
decisions.reason: The lion kills, takes its prey back to its den, and no shepherd can get it back (Micah 5:7; Isaiah 5:29). The "going" leads into verse 15: "I will go back to my place".

decisions.choice: tear them to pieces ... carry them off ... rescue them
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable supply the object "them", the people of the two kingdoms, which the Hebrew leaves out.

decisions.choice: "mimi, mimi" (L); "Mimi, naam mimi" (B); spans on each pronoun inside the sentence
decisions.reason: The doubled pronoun stresses that the LORD himself, not Assyria, is the lion (m2). At Literal it stands inside the sentence after a line break, so both take the deity_pronoun span; at Balanced the first opens a sentence and is written plainly with its capital, and the second takes the span. "kwenda zangu" (go my way) is his free possessive and takes the span too. Readable starts a new sentence with "Mimi mwenyewe".

source.text: אֵלֵ֤ךְ אָשׁ֨וּבָה֙ אֶל־מְקוֹמִ֔י עַ֥ד אֲשֶֽׁר־יֶאְשְׁמ֖וּ וּבִקְשׁ֣וּ פָנָ֑י בַּצַּ֥ר לָהֶ֖ם יְשַׁחֲרֻֽנְנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: I will go, I will return to my place, until that they bear guilt and seek my face; in their distress they will seek me earnestly.

en.L: I will go, I will return to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} place, \q until they bear their guilt and seek {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} face; \q in their distress they will seek {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} earnestly.
en.B: I will return to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} place \q until they confess their guilt and seek {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} face. \q In their distress they will search for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} eagerly.
en.R: Then I will go back to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} place \q until they admit they are guilty and come looking for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. \q When they are in trouble, they will try hard to find {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.

es.L: Me iré, volveré a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} lugar, \q hasta que reconozcan su culpa y busquen {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} rostro; \q en su angustia {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} buscarán con ansia.
es.B: Volveré a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} lugar \q hasta que confiesen su culpa y busquen {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} rostro. \q En su angustia {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} buscarán con empeño.
es.R: Entonces volveré a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} lugar \q hasta que admitan que son culpables y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} vengan a buscar. \q Cuando estén en apuros, {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} buscarán con todas sus fuerzas.

fr.L: Je {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}en irai, je reviendrai à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} lieu, \q jusqu’à ce qu’ils portent leur culpabilité et recherchent {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} face ; \q dans leur détresse, ils {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} chercheront avec empressement.
fr.B: Je reviendrai à {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} demeure \q jusqu’à ce qu’ils reconnaissent leur culpabilité et recherchent {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} face. \q Dans leur détresse, ils {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} chercheront avec ardeur.
fr.R: Puis je reviendrai chez {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} \q jusqu’à ce qu’ils reconnaissent qu’ils sont coupables et qu’ils viennent {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} chercher. \q Quand ils seront dans le malheur, ils feront tout pour {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} trouver.

ko.L: 내가 가서 내 처소로 돌아가겠다. \q 그들이 죄를 인정하고 내 얼굴을 찾을 때까지. \q 그들이 고난 가운데서 나를 간절히 찾을 것이다.
ko.B: 나는 내 처소로 돌아가 있겠다. \q 그들이 죄를 뉘우치고 내 얼굴을 찾을 때까지 그렇게 하겠다. \q 그들은 고난을 당하면 나를 간절히 찾을 것이다.
ko.R: 그런 다음 나는 내 자리로 돌아가겠다. \q 그들이 자기 죄를 인정하고 나를 찾아올 때까지 기다리겠다. \q 그들은 어려움을 당하면 나를 찾으려고 애쓸 것이다.

vi.L: Ta sẽ đi, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ trở về chỗ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q cho đến khi chúng nhận lấy tội mình và tìm kiếm mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}; \q trong lúc khốn quẫn chúng sẽ thiết tha tìm kiếm {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.B: Ta sẽ trở về chỗ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} \q cho đến khi chúng nhận tội và tìm kiếm mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Trong cơn hoạn nạn, chúng sẽ hết lòng tìm kiếm {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ trở về chỗ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} \q cho đến khi chúng nhận mình có tội và đến tìm {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Khi gặp hoạn nạn, chúng sẽ cố gắng tìm {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

sw.L: Nitakwenda, nitarudi mahali {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}}, \q mpaka watakapobeba hatia yao na kuutafuta uso {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}; \q katika dhiki yao watanitafuta kwa bidii.
sw.B: Nitarudi mahali {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}} \q mpaka watakapokiri hatia yao na kuutafuta uso {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. \q Katika dhiki yao watanitafuta kwa bidii.
sw.R: Kisha nitarudi mahali {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}} \q mpaka watakapokubali kuwa wana hatia na kuja kunitafuta. \q Watakapokuwa katika taabu, watajitahidi sana kunipata.

pt.L: Irei, voltarei para o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} lugar, \q até que eles carreguem a sua culpa e busquem a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} face; \q na sua angústia eles {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} buscarão com empenho.
pt.B: Voltarei para o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} lugar \q até que confessem a sua culpa e busquem a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} face. \q Na sua angústia, eles {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} procurarão com ansiedade.
pt.R: Então vou voltar para o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} lugar \q até que eles admitam que são culpados e venham {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} procurar. \q Quando estiverem em dificuldade, vão se esforçar para {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} encontrar.

decisions.choice: I will go, I will return to my place: the LORD withdraws his presence
decisions.reason: Like the lion returning to its den (verse 14), the LORD goes back to his dwelling and leaves his people to the results of their sin. This is the withdrawal spoken of in verse 6.

decisions.choice: bear their guilt: feel and admit their guilt
alternatives: until they have paid for their guilt
decisions.reason: The verb means to be guilty or to bear the consequences of guilt. Here, set beside seeking the LORD's face, it means that they acknowledge their guilt.

decisions.choice: seek my face: come to the LORD to find his favor
decisions.reason: To seek someone's face is to seek to come before him and gain his favor (2 Samuel 21:1; Psalm 27:8). The last line says that in their distress they will "seek me earnestly", a verb used of searching early or eagerly. Hosea 6:1-3 follows with words of return that the people speak.

decisions.choice: come looking for me
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what "seek my face" means (m3).
